title: Command Palette dock top the pin apps keep disappearing, plus would love to have the date in the top right next to the clock
summary: Command Palette dock pinned apps reportedly disappear; the report also requests a date next to the clock.

judgment.rationale: The scenario requires a discriminating comparison before the failing boundary can be established.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter says dock pins disappear and toggling a taskbar setting off and on restores them; another user says it also occurred in the previous version.
The report does not say whether disappearance occurs during a session or after restart, or whether the pins remain in settings.
Inspected src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/CommandProviderWrapper.cs: dock pin settings are resolved against provider commands; this does not prove which step fails.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the focused comparison and avoid claiming a cause or covering fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction or supported behavior investigation may be applicable after resolving the identified uncertainty.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate disappearing dock pins
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A pin can disappear because of persistence, provider resolution or display refresh; the report does not distinguish these.
plan: Determine whether the pins disappear during a session or after restart and whether their configuration persists.
Compare saved settings, provider resolution and dock refresh on a current build, accounting for #47169 and #51036.
Fix a demonstrated remaining loss or display failure without overwriting user pin choices.
Add focused regression coverage for the observed failure path.
verification: Configured pins remain visible or recover correctly after the reproduced transition.
Other dock bands and clock settings remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The reported failure boundary and current behavior are not yet established.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette dock pinned apps reportedly disappear; the report also requests a date next to the clock.
known_information: On 0.99.1 the reporter says dock pins disappear and toggling a taskbar setting off and on restores them; another user says it also occurred in the previous version.
The report does not say whether disappearance occurs during a session or after restart, or whether the pins remain in settings.
inferences: A pin can disappear because of persistence, provider resolution or display refresh; the report does not distinguish these.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/CommandProviderWrapper.cs: dock pin settings are resolved against provider commands; this does not prove which step fails.

Merged PR #47169 refreshes dock state on pin/unpin; merged #51036 serializes settings saves that could lose pins after restart. Neither establishes the cause of this report. Linked #51079 discusses current clock date/time space rather than missing pins.
issue_context.analysis: The report and current source do not establish a root cause or a covering fix; distinguish observed behavior from hypothesis.

information_gaps.information: When the pins disappear and whether they still appear in the dock configuration when missing.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes the possible failure boundaries before selecting an implementation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reporter checks whether it happens after restart or during a session and whether the same pins remain configured.

comment.body:
Thanks for explaining that toggling the setting brings the pins back, and for the report that this occurred in an earlier version. Could you clarify:

- Do the pins disappear while Command Palette is running, or only after restarting it or Windows?
- When they are missing, are the same pins still listed in the dock configuration?

This distinguishes a display/refresh problem from lost settings. The clock date request can be considered separately.
